text:
The largest bone in the human body is the femur, also known as the thigh bone.

***

A cavern vast where wisdom sleeps,
In silent halls where knowledge keeps
Its countless doors, one spine at a time,
To worlds unknown, in rhythm and rhyme.

Each volume holds a life untold,
A story waiting to unfold,
Beneath the gaze of one who knows
The secrets that the pages show.

The librarian, with ancient eyes,
Beneath the library’s quiet skies,
Guardian of the bound and deep,
Where human dreams and truths all sleep.
